uslaw-usc-t2-s142f:
Section 142f of Title 2 makes the Library of Congress the paymaster for a technology office. From October 1, 1981 onward, the Disbursing Officer of the Library is authorized to disburse funds appropriated for the Office of Technology Assessment. The Library must also provide financial management support to that office.

The support is given as required and as mutually agreed by the Librarian of Congress and the Director of the technology office. The Library is further authorized to compute and disburse the basic pay of all personnel of that office. That payroll work follows a Title 5 provision named in the text. Vouchers certified by the Library's certifying officers need backing. They must be supported by a certification from an authorized officer or employee of the technology office. The section sits in Chapter 5 of Title 2.
